notes: The source URL and text are the Photography, Associate in Arts page; 'Photography, Certificate of Achievement' appears only as a navigation link. The text contains no requirements section for the certificate, so no blocks or totals are recorded.

The only course listing is the A.A. Plan of Study grid (61 total units, tied to the VCCCD General Education Pattern), which names ART V11A, PHOT V01, V02, V04A, V06A, PHOT V07/ART V02E, V08, V09A and unnamed 'Additional Required Courses' and 'Elective PHOT Course' slots; it is not the certificate's requirements.

The page's outcomes tab prints three program student learning outcomes ('Demonstrate skills in camera operation, as well as film and digital printing.'; 'Create and critique photographic works utilizing appropriate compositional considerations.'; 'Research and discuss past and present works, recognize and analyze the history and social role of photographic images.') on the A.A. page; not recorded because the text does not show that the certificate shares them. A reviewer should check the certificate page (photography-certificate-of-achievement) for its requirements and outcomes.
